newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Belgian minister to discuss Zaire crisis in Addis.
newsitem.headline: Belgian minister to discuss Zaire crisis in Addis.

text.p: Belgian Foreign Minister Erik Derycke will visit Addis Ababa on Monday to discuss the crisis in Zaire with officials of the Ethiopian government and the Organisation of African Unity (OAU), the embassy announced.
It said Derycke would hold talks with OAU Secretary-General Salim Ahmed Salim and Ethiopian officials.
He is to hold a news conference before leaving on Tuesday.
Belgium, the former colonial master in Zaire, has not committed itself to contributing any troops for a proposed neutral force for Zaire to help feed more than a million stranded refugees.
